# Veekay Cabs

> Veekay Cabs is a self-drive car rental and Tempo Traveller hire company serving Delhi NCR (Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, and Greater Noida). Customers book hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs, and luxury self-drive cars, or hire 9 to 26 seater Tempo Travellers for group travel, weddings, pilgrimages, and corporate trips — all online, with doorstep delivery and transparent pricing.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://veekaycabs.com/): Overview of self-drive car rental and Tempo Traveller services in Delhi NCR.
- [Book a Car](https://veekaycabs.com/book): Search and book available self-drive cars by city and date.
- [Tempo Traveller](https://veekaycabs.com/tempo-traveller): Hire 9 to 26 seater AC Tempo Travellers for group travel.
- [Tempo Traveller Listing](https://veekaycabs.com/tempo-traveller/listing): Browse available Tempo Travellers by seating capacity and price.
- [About Us](https://veekaycabs.com/about): Company background and service areas.
- [Contact Us](https://veekaycabs.com/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, and office address.
- [Blog](https://veekaycabs.com/blog): Travel guides, rental tips, and destination guides for Delhi NCR.
